name: Signal Cluster S59: Order Flow & Market Structure
description: Exercises: swing_highs_lows, bos_choch, fair_value_gap, order_blocks, liquidity, retracements, previous_high_low
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S59: Order Flow & Market Structure
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
o = src.o
h = src.h
l = src.l
c = src.c
v = src.v

# === SWING STRUCTURE (foundation for chain) ===
shl = swing_highs_lows(swing_length=7)(h=h, l=l)

# === BREAK OF STRUCTURE / CHANGE OF CHARACTER ===
structure = bos_choch(close_break=False)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c, high_low=shl.high_low, level=shl.level)

# === FAIR VALUE GAP (standalone) ===
fvg = fair_value_gap(join_consecutive=True)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === ORDER BLOCKS ===
ob = order_blocks(close_mitigation=False)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c, v=v, high_low=shl.high_low)

# === LIQUIDITY POOLS ===
liq = liquidity()(h=h, l=l, high_low=shl.high_low, level=shl.level)

# === RETRACEMENTS ===
retrace = retracements()(h=h, l=l, high_low=shl.high_low, level=shl.level)

# === PREVIOUS HIGH/LOW ===
pdhl = previous_high_low(interval=1, type=SessionTimeframe.day)(h=h, l=l)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Swing Levels',
    category='Structure',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Swing Level', color=Color.Yellow)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=shl.level)

xy_lines(
    title='FVG Zones',
    category='Structure',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FVG Top', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FVG Bottom', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fvg.top, fvg.bottom))

xy_lines(
    title='Retracement',
    category='Structure',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deepest', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(retrace.current_retracement, retrace.deepest_retracement))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='BOS', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Level', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Break of Structure'
    )
)(structure.bos, structure.level, structure.bos != 0)
